titles.notes: Source of title: Honolulu Museum of Art. This was the original title as far as the Honolulu Museum of Art can determine, but was changed to "Papaya Tree" at some point without noting reason for change. It appears in older publications with this title. Curator K. Love decided to use this title when reinstalled in March 2019.

description: A tall papaw tree with a smooth brown trunk and rounded masses of green leaves rises through the center of the composition. Tall green and blue mountains stand behind the tree, cutting diagonally through the composition. White mist and clouds hover over the scene.
